about: Questions the protocol v3 pool leaves out, by rule. Consensus data: the pool manifest's hashes cover the result, and scripts/check_safety_invariants.py pins this file's sha256.

all_fail.rule: Questions every graded model failed on random v2 exploration calls (e00026349-e00026384, coldkey-median grades) where at least four models failed, at least two of them strong: most likely wrong answer keys.

routerarena.rule: RouterArena (RouteWorks/RouterArena, full split @ a4a062ce3313b56bb09c042e1bc37b61d34e3bd8) is an evaluation-only set: routers trained on its questions are rejected. Every pool question whose text matches one of its 8,400 (12-word shingles, at least half shared) is left out.

routerarena_code.rule: The LeetCode problems RouterArena takes from LiveCodeBench release_v2, by slug (the LeetCodeDataset task_id). LiveCodeBench itself is not in the pool.
